def: Running a program so that its progress is stored outside the process, letting a new process continue after a crash without losing work or repeating completed steps.
An append-only record of every model reply, tool result and human decision in a run, from which the run's current state can be rebuilt.
A saved snapshot of an agent's state at a known point, loaded after a crash so the run continues from there rather than from the start.
A unique string sent with a request so the service can recognise a repeat and return the first outcome instead of acting twice.
A delivery guarantee under which an action is retried until acknowledged, so it may happen more than once and the receiver must tolerate repeats.
The observable result of at-least-once attempts combined with idempotent handling, so that the world changes as if the action ran exactly once.
Recovering a workflow by re-running its code against a recorded history, which only works if the code makes the same decisions for the same history.
In Temporal, a unit of work that touches the outside world, whose result is stored in the history and reused during replay instead of running again.
A stored, folded copy of state together with the log position it covers, so recovery replays only the events after it.
A point in a run where the agent proposes an action and stops until a human decision, recorded as an event bound to the exact arguments, allows it to continue.
A step that crashes the process every time it runs, so a resuming agent loops on it unless attempts are counted and limited.
